neighbours.label: the point in a competition or judging rule where the deciding criterion is stated ('based on the', 'goes to the', 'with the'), anticipating a superlative such as faster, most or highest
fire: Each team gets three attempts, and the winner is decided by the best of them.
The trophy goes to the player with the highest score at the end of the night.
Each rider jumps twice and is ranked on the better of the two jumps.
The scholarship is awarded to the student with the strongest essay.
Every runner gets two laps, and the final time is based on the quicker lap.
First prize goes to the baker with the tallest cake in the contest.
Each archer shoots twice, and placement depends on the closer arrow.
The medal is given to the swimmer with the fastest time in the final.
quiet: Each team gets three snacks, and the bus leaves at the end of the trip.
The trophy sits on a shelf in the lobby at the end of the hall.
Each rider brings a helmet and rides along the trail by the river.
The scholarship office is open on Mondays near the main library.
Every runner gets a shirt, and the race starts near the old bridge.
First, the baker mixes flour and sugar in a large bowl.
Each archer carries a quiver and walks to the field after lunch.
The medal is kept in a glass case at the town museum.
